fields.title: 📖 Ijmāʿ: A consensus transmitted by single reports also has probative force
fields.body:
🖋️ **aš-Šawkānī** explained:

> ***“aš-Šawkānī said: The Ijmāʿ that is transmitted by the path of Āḥād is a Ḥujjah; this was said by al-Māwardī, Imām al-Ḥaramayn and al-Āmidī.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Not every Ijmāʿ is transmitted with equal strength, but a reliably reported Ijmāʿ is not simply made worthless.

immutable.source: 📝 aš-Šawkānī, Iršād al-Fuḥūl ilā Taḥqīq al-Ḥaqq min ʿIlm al-Uṣūl, Bd. 1, S. 277, Abschnitt: Ḥujjiyyat al-Ijmāʿ al-Manqūl bi-Ṭarīq al-Āḥād.
